blind.description: A deceased armored adventurer or skeleton lying supine on a tattered red cloak with a rolled pack under the head. The figure wears dark tarnished plate armor, iron boots, and an open-faced helmet revealing a pale skull-like face. A round green-and-bronze shield with a central boss rests across the lower torso, and a sword is grasped along the right side. Geometry is solid and continuous with no hovering flakes, melted artifacts, or unpainted voids.
blind.from_above: An armored warrior lying flat on their back, framed by a ragged red cloak with a bedroll at the head, holding a sword along the right side and bearing a round green-and-bronze shield on the abdomen.
blind.height_vs_figure: Lying flat, it stands only about 1 to 1.5 ft off the ground, but its length is roughly 5.5 to 6 ft (comparable to the full height of the standing reference figure), and about 2.5 ft wide.

notes: underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
